name: Coupled Pendulums & Elastic Cord
desc: A laboratory-style array of 1–10 pendulums tied to a sagging elastic cord. Explore real shared-support force transmission, resonance, variable pendulum lengths, mechanical energy and WebM video.
shortDesc: Investigate coupled pendulums, movable knots, string sag, resonance and energy conservation.
learningObjectives: Compare one to ten pendulums tied to a shared flexible support
Explore conservation of mechanical energy, damping and external work
Demonstrate resonance and energy transfer between oscillators
Compare independent supports against a coupled elastic cord
modelAssumptions: Discrete tension-only elastic cord with finite-mass material knots
Pendulum beads move in the vertical plane
Fixed endpoints and small but nonzero elastic deformation
